This Mfa Filed U/S.74(1) Of Land Acquisition Act,
Rehabilitation And Resettlement Act, 2013 Against The
Judgment And Award Dated 27.01.2022 Passed In Lac
No.260/2018 On The File Of The I Additional District And
Sessions Judge, Ramanagara, Partly Allowing The
Reference Petition Filed U/S.64 Of The Right To Fair
Compensation And Transparency In Land Acquisition And
Rehabilitation And Resettlement Act, 2013.
 This Appeal, Coming On For Orders, This Day,
Judgment Was Delivered Therein As Under:
Coram: Hon'Ble Smt. Justice Lalitha Kanneganti
 Oral Judgment
When this matter came up on 04.09.2024, as there was no representation on behalf of the appellant and this court had directed the matter to be listed under the caption for 'dismissal' on 12.09.2024.
Today when the matter came up there is no representation on behalf of the appellant.
It appears that the appellant is not interested to pursue the matter.
NC: 2024:KHC:37585 Accordingly, the appeal is dismissed for non- prosecution.

SD/-
(LALITHA KANNEGANTI) JUDGE TS The Executive Engnieer vs Ningamma on 12 September, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/24298967/
